articles.title: Toronto police looking for suspect in Beaches area break and enter
articles.summary: Toronto Police are looking for a suspect allegedly involved in a break and enter at an apartment building in The Beaches. articles.title: Premier Ford calls three provincial byelections for Sept. 3
articles.summary: Premier Doug Ford has announced the date for three provincial byelections. Voters in Scarborough Southwest, York-Simcoe and Hamilton East-Stoney Creek will go to the polls on Sept. 3. articles.title: Fort York Boulevard reopens after 3-vehicle collision in downtown Toronto
articles.summary: Fort York Boulevard has reopened after a collision involving three vehicles closed a portion of it on Wednesday morning. Police were called to the area of Fort York Boulevard and Spadina Avenue around 9:35 a.m. for reports of a three-vehicle collision where one of the vehicles had flipped over. articles.title: Ford calls byelections in 3 Ontario ridings
articles.summary: A writ was issued Wednesday for byelections in Scarborough Southwest, York–Simcoe and Hamilton East–Stoney Creek. In a news release, the province said that voting day will be on Sept. 3.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead following vehicle collision in Brampton: police
articles.summary: A motorcyclist is dead following a collision with a vehicle in Brampton Tuesday morning, Peel police say.

articles.title: 1 dead in Scarborough apartment fire
articles.summary: One person is dead after a fire broke out in a Scarborough apartment building Tuesday morning, Toronto police and paramedics say.

articles.title: Canadian 'vigilantes' confronted New York sex offender 2 years before arrest
articles.summary: The FBI investigated a New York man in 2024 after Canadian 'vigilantes' confronted him and warned he had travelled to sexually abuse a minor. It took another two years and a girl’s disappearance for the man to be arrested and charged, according to U.S. court records reviewed by CBC News.

articles.title: 2 women dead after Highway 401 collision near Gananoque
articles.summary: Two women from the Greater Toronto Area were killed Monday after their vehicle hit a tractor-trailer parked on the shoulder of Highway 401 near Gananoque, Ont., according to the Ontario Provincial Police.
